column1:
cable
Two or more insulated conductors inside a common outer sheath.
I need five metres of cable.
column2:
כבל
kevel
m · pl. כבלים
אני צריך חמישה מטר כבל.
כבל is the sheathed multi-core thing; a single conductor is חוט. Suppliers hold the distinction.

column1:
wire (single conductor)
A single insulated conductor, sold by the metre off a reel, pulled through conduit.
Do you have 1.5mm red wire?
column2:
חוט
khut
m · pl. חוטים
יש לכם חוט אדום אחד וחצי?
Same word as thread/string in everyday Hebrew. This is the category for rewiring inside existing conduit; כבל is for a run you lay yourself.

column1:
core / conductor within a cable
One of the individual insulated conductors inside a cable. A 3-core cable is כבל תלת גידי or כבל 3 גידים.
Three-core or five-core?
column2:
גיד
gid
m · pl. גידים
כבל תלת גידי או חמישה גידים?
Literally 'tendon/sinew'. This is the word that lets you read a cable spec out loud.

column1:
cable size, e.g. 3 x 1.5mm²
How a cable spec is said at the counter: number of cores 'by' cross-section in mm².
Ten metres of 3x1.5 cable please.
column2:
3 על 1.5
shalosh al ekhad va-khetzi
תן לי בבקשה עשרה מטר כבל 3 על 1.5.
The mm² goes unsaid — nobody says מילימטר רבוע across a counter. על here is just the multiplication 'by'.

column1:
cross-section (of a conductor)
Conductor cross-sectional area in mm² — the number that decides how much current the cable carries.
What's the cross-section of this cable?
column2:
חתך
khatakh
m · pl. חתכים
מה החתך של הכבל הזה?
Appears on spec sheets and filter menus. Spoken, people just say the number.

column1:
flexible cable
Stranded-core cable that bends without breaking — appliance leads, extension leads, anything that moves.
For that you want flexible cable, not solid wire.
column2:
כבל גמיש
kevel gamish
m · pl. כבלים גמישים
לזה עדיף כבל גמיש, לא חוט קשיח.
The category for a lead you terminate yourself. Often written כבל גמיש PVC.

column1:
control cable
Multi-core signalling cable for switching and control circuits rather than carrying load — panels, motors, gate controllers.
column2:
כבל פיקוד
kevel pikud
m · pl. כבלי פיקוד
פיקוד = command/control. Not needed for domestic DIY; shows up wiring a gate motor or boiler controller.

column1:
power cable
Cable that carries load current, as opposed to signal or control.
column2:
כבל כוח
kevel koakh
m · pl. כבלי כוח
Trap: כבל חשמל is the everyday phrase for an appliance's power lead, while כבל כוח on a supplier's site means installation-grade cable. Searching כבל חשמל gets you kettle leads.

column1:
low voltage (LV)
In distribution terms, up to 1kV — which includes ordinary 230V mains.
column2:
מתח נמוך
metakh namukh
False friend. To an electrician מתח נמוך still means mains; the 12V/24V stuff an English speaker calls 'low voltage' is מתח נמוך מאוד or just '12 וולט'.

column1:
medium voltage (MV)
Distribution voltage between LV and HV, roughly 1kV–36kV. Utility and industrial only.
column2:
מתח ביניים
metakh beinayim
If a category is מתח ביניים it is not for you. Useful purely as a signpost to skip.

column1:
fire-resistant cable
Cable that keeps a circuit alive during a fire — required for life-safety systems. Usually the orange one.
column2:
כבל חסין אש
kevel khasin esh
m · pl. כבלים חסיני אש
חסין = immune/resistant, same root as חיסון (vaccine). Distinct from כבל נטול הלוגן (halogen-free), which is about smoke toxicity rather than circuit survival.

column1:
cable accessories
Termination and jointing hardware: lugs, glands, sleeves, ties, joints.
column2:
אביזרים לכבלים
avizarim le-kvalim
אביזר is the general word for a fitting across every trade — אביזרי אינסטלציה for plumbing, אביזרי חשמל for sockets and switches.

column1:
cable lug / ring terminal
The crimped metal end fitting that lets a stranded conductor be bolted to a terminal — the items pictured under אביזרים לכבלים.
column2:
נעל כבל
na'al kevel
f · pl. נעלי כבל
Literally 'cable shoe', same metaphor as German Kabelschuh. Crimping is לכווץ, with a מכווץ.

column1:
shielded / screened
Has a braid or foil screen against interference — the tinned braid visible on the כבל פיקוד in the photo.
column2:
מסוכך
mesukhakh
Root סכך, to shade or cover, as in סוכה. Feminine מסוככת.

column1:
armoured
Has a steel wire or tape armour layer for direct burial or mechanical protection.
column2:
משוריין
meshuryan
Same word as an armoured vehicle — רכב משוריין. Sticks first time here.

column1:
stranded (vs solid)
Conductor made of many fine strands twisted together, hence flexible. The opposite — solid — is קשיח or מלא.
column2:
שזור
shazur
Needs checking: confirm whether a supplier's shelf label says שזור or גדילי. Spec sheets and speech may differ.

column1:
conductor
The metal that carries the current; also the adjective 'conductive'.
column2:
מוליך
molikh
m · pl. מוליכים
Causative of הוליך, to lead. מוליך פאזה = live conductor, מוליך הארקה = earth conductor.

column1:
insulation
The insulating layer; also thermal and acoustic insulation in building work.
You need to strip the insulation.
column2:
בידוד
bidud
m · pl. בידודים
צריך לקלף את הבידוד.
One word covers three trades: בידוד תרמי, בידוד אקוסטי, and electrical. Stripping it is לקלף, to peel.

column1:
earth / ground
Earthing, and the earth conductor — the green-yellow one.
There's no earth here.
column2:
הארקה
ha'araka
f · pl. הארקות
אין פה הארקה.
From ארץ. The wire itself is חוט הארקה, colour ירוק-צהוב.

column1:
neutral
The neutral conductor. Literally 'zero'.
The live and neutral are swapped here.
column2:
אפס
efes
m
הפאזה והאפס מתחלפים פה.
Nobody says נייטרלי about wiring. Colour blue (כחול); in older installations, black.

column1:
live / phase
The live conductor. Also 'phase' as in single- vs three-phase supply — חד פאזי / תלת פאזי.
Do you have three-phase in the flat?
column2:
פאזה
faza
f · pl. פאזות
יש לך שלוש פאזות בדירה?
Universally borrowed; no native word in use. Colour brown (חום) in new work.

column1:
circuit breaker (MCB)
The individual breaker for one circuit, in the consumer unit.
My breaker tripped.
column2:
אוטומט
otomat
m · pl. אוטומטים
קפץ לי האוטומט.
מא"ז (formal) — Acronym for מפסק אוטומטי זעיר. What the packaging and the electrician's invoice say; אוטומט is what everyone says out loud.
The verb for tripping is קפץ, jumped. Textbook case of the dictionary word being useless in a shop.

column1:
RCD / residual current device
Earth-leakage protection — mandatory in Israeli domestic installations.
The RCD trips every time I turn on the boiler.
column2:
פחת
pakhat
m
הפחת יורד כל פעם שאני מדליק את הדוד.
ממסר פחת (formal) — Full form, on labels and in regulations. Shortened to just פחת in speech.
פחת means loss or depletion, i.e. the leaked current. Verb for tripping is יורד or קפץ.

column1:
consumer unit / distribution board
The board with the breakers in it.
Where's the flat's consumer unit?
column2:
לוח חשמל
luakh khashmal
m · pl. לוחות חשמל
איפה לוח החשמל של הדירה?

column1:
socket / outlet
The thing on the wall you plug into.
column2:
שקע
sheka
m · pl. שקעים
Root שקע, to sink or recess — a flush one is שקע שקוע, a surface one שקע חיצוני or על הטיח.

column1:
plug
The plug on the end of a lead.
column2:
תקע
teka
m · pl. תקעים
שקע and תקע differ by one letter and are constantly confused. Mnemonic: תקע shares its root with לתקוע, to stick in.

column1:
switch (light switch, isolator)
Anything that breaks a circuit: a light switch, a main isolator (מפסק ראשי).
column2:
מפסק
mafsek
m · pl. מפסקים
מתג (trade) — Also 'switch', but skews to small switches on devices — and in IT, מתג is specifically a network switch.

column1:
junction box
The box where cables are joined, behind the plaster or on the surface.
column2:
קופסת חיבורים
kufsat khiburim
f · pl. קופסאות חיבורים
Often shortened to קופסה in context. The recessed pattress behind a socket is קופסת התקנה.

column1:
corrugated conduit / flexible trunking
The ribbed plastic pipe that wires are pulled through inside walls.
There's conduit in the wall, we can pull a new wire through.
column2:
צינור שרשורי
tzinor shakhshuri
m · pl. צינורות שרשוריים
יש שרשורי בקיר, אפשר להשחיל חוט חדש.
Usually shortened to שרשורי on its own. Pulling wire through it is להשחיל, to thread.

column1:
terminal block / connector strip
Screw or spring terminal for joining conductors.
column2:
מהדק
mahadek
m · pl. מהדקים
Root הדק, to tighten — same as a trigger. The lever type is widely called by the brand name וואגו; ask for וואגו and you will be understood.

column1:
cut to length
Asking a supplier to cut a length off the reel for you.
Can you cut me seven metres?
column2:
לחתוך במידה
lakhtokh be-mida
אפשר לחתוך לי שבעה מטר?
מידה = measure. The simplest counter form is just אפשר לחתוך לי X מטר? — the fuller phrase is not needed.

column1:
sold by the metre
Pricing off the reel rather than by the packaged unit.
Is this sold by the metre?
column2:
לפי מטר
lefi meter
זה נמכר לפי מטר?
Needs checking: flooring and fabric use מטר רץ (running metre); for cable, plain מטר seems to be the norm.

column1:
reel / drum / coil
The coil the cable comes on. Buying a whole one is usually cheaper per metre.
How much for a full reel?
column2:
גליל
galil
m · pl. גלילים
כמה עולה גליל שלם?

column1:
extension lead
A lead that extends reach, with one socket on the end.
column2:
כבל מאריך
kevel ma'arikh
m · pl. כבלים מאריכים
מאריך (colloquial) — Usually said on its own.
Distinct from רב שקע, the multi-way strip. Israelis keep the two apart more sharply than English speakers do.

column1:
power strip / multi-socket
The multi-way trailing socket block.
column2:
רב שקע
rav sheka
m · pl. רבי שקע
Written רב שקע or רב-שקע. Listed on Ivory as רב שקע חשמל.

column1:
splitter
One input to several outputs — HDMI, USB, aerial.
column2:
מפצל
mefatzel
m · pl. מפצלים
Root פצל, to split. Ivory files מפצלי USB and מפצלי HDMI alongside רב שקע חשמל under one heading.

column1:
adapter
Converts one connector or standard to another — מתאם HDMI, מתאם רשת, מתאם חשמל.
column2:
מתאם
mat'em
m · pl. מתאמים
Not the same as מטען (charger), though shops sometimes label a power brick מתאם חשמל.

column1:
UPS / uninterruptible power supply
Battery backup that keeps equipment running through a cut.
column2:
אל פסק
al pasek
m · pl. אל פסקים
A Hebrew coinage that won outright — nobody says יו-פי-אס. Built on the אל- negation prefix, like אלחוטי (wireless).

column1:
surge protector
Surge and spike protection. Literally 'lightning shield'.
column2:
מגן ברקים
magen brakim
m · pl. מגני ברקים

column1:
transformer
Steps voltage up or down.
column2:
שנאי
shanai
m · pl. שנאים
Root שנה, to change. A 12V LED driver gets called a ספק or a שנאי depending on who you ask.

column1:
charger
Phone or laptop charger.
column2:
מטען
mat'en
m · pl. מטענים
Homograph trap: מטען also means a cargo load and, in the news, an explosive charge. Context carries it.

column1:
power bank
Portable battery pack.
column2:
סוללת גיבוי ניידת
solelat gibuy nayedet
f · pl. סוללות גיבוי ניידות
פאוור בנק (colloquial) — What people actually say. The full Hebrew phrase is catalogue language.
Ivory's own menu says סוללת גיבוי ניידת — a clean example of the gap between catalogue Hebrew and speech.

column1:
network cable / patch lead
Ethernet cable. רשת = net or network.
column2:
כבל רשת
kevel reshet
m · pl. כבלי רשת
Nobody says כבל אתרנט. Wired vs wireless is קווי / אלחוטי.

column1:
monitor
Computer display. Usually just מסך in context.
column2:
מסך מחשב
masakh makhshev
m · pl. מסכי מחשב

column1:
monitor arm
Articulating desk mount. זרוע = arm, anatomical.
column2:
זרוע למסך
zroa le-masakh
f · pl. זרועות למסך
Ivory heads the category זרועות תלייה ומעמדים — arms for hanging, and stands.

column1:
paper shredder
Shreds documents. Root גרס, to crush or grind.
column2:
מגרסה
magresa
f · pl. מגרסות

column1:
laminator
Laminating machine. Hebrew frame word plus borrowed noun.
column2:
מכשיר למינציה
makhshir laminatzia
m · pl. מכשירי למינציה
מכשיר / מכונה is the generic device frame that carries most borrowed appliance names.

column1:
ink cartridge
Inkjet cartridge. Literally 'ink head'.
column2:
ראש דיו
rosh dyo
m · pl. ראשי דיו
Toner is simply טונר. מחסנית also appears on some packaging but is the firearms-magazine word.

column1:
smart home
Home automation as a retail category.
column2:
בית חכם
bayit khakham
m
Ivory files it as תאורה ובית חכם — lighting and smart home together, which is how Israeli retail segments it.

column1:
rate limiting
Capping request frequency against an API.
The server is rate limiting me.
column2:
הגבלת קצב
hagbalat ketzev
f
השרת מגביל לי את הקצב.
In an Israeli dev conversation the English is at least as likely: עשו לי rate limit. Mid-sentence code-switching is the norm in tech.

column1:
API
Application programming interface.
Do they have an API?
column2:
ממשק תכנות
mimshak tikhnut
m · pl. ממשקי תכנות
יש להם API?
API (borrowed) — What developers say, always. The Hebrew is documentation-only.
ממשק on its own is genuinely used — ממשק משתמש for UI is ordinary speech.

column1:
AI agent
An autonomous LLM-driven agent.
We built an agent to handle our CRM integration.
column2:
סוכן AI
sokhen ei-ai
m · pl. סוכני AI
בנינו סוכן שמטפל באינטגרציה עם ה-CRM.
סוכן בינה מלאכותית (formal) — Full Hebrew form, used in press and marketing copy.
סוכן also means a sales agent and a spy; in tech context nobody misreads it. בינה מלאכותית is genuinely in use, unlike most Academy coinages.

column1:
LLM / large language model
Large language model.
Do you know a good Hebrew-native LLM?
column2:
מודל שפה גדול
model safa gadol
m · pl. מודלי שפה גדולים
אתה מכיר איזה LLM טוב בעברית?
LLM (borrowed) — Standard in speech among practitioners.
מודל is itself a borrowing that fully naturalised, taking a Hebrew plural.

column1:
TTS / text to speech
Speech synthesis.
Which TTS is reliable in Hebrew?
column2:
טקסט לדיבור
tekst le-dibur
m
איזה TTS אמין בעברית?
הקראה (trade) — 'Reading aloud' — used for the accessibility feature rather than the technology category.
TTS (borrowed) — What practitioners say.
